title: The Other Boleyn Girl
author: Philippa Gregory
summary: At the court of Henry VIII, the ambitious Boleyn family pushes a young daughter into the king's bed. Her sister Anne soon takes her place, and both are caught between family loyalty and rivalry.
readIf: you want a page-turning, soapy take on the Tudor court that is full of rivalry and bad decisions.
skipIf: you want strict history, as the novel changes and dramatises many events.

pairings.reason: Covers the same court and period in much more literary, probing prose and from the opposite point of view.
Another long, romantic historical saga that mixes love, danger and a strong heroine.
A sweeping family drama of forbidden desire and ambition, in a very different setting.
